```{r parameters}

#The number of agent populations (determined by prior simulation)
populations<-length(list.files("model-outputs/sex-evolution/",full.names=T))



#Number of generations
generations<-100



#Minimum resources for offspring viability
resourceThreshold<-5



#Total resources agents will have for producing gametes
resources<-resourceThreshold*20



#Maximum number of gametes an agent will be allowed to produce
maxGametes<-100



#Scales the likelihood of dying as a function of investment in mate competition
#Max investors will have p = mateCompetitionCost probability of dying before gamete production
mateCompetitionCost<-(.05)

#Scales the increase in likelihood of reproducing as a function of investment in mate competition
#Investment in mate competition will explain mateCompetitionBenefit % of the variance in reproduction priority
mateCompetitionBenefit<-(.50)



#Scales the impact of investment in parenting on gamete production budget
#Max investors will have their gamete budget reduced to resources * (1-parentingCost)
parentingCost<-(.05)

#Scales the benefit of investment in parenting on offspring survival 
#Investment in parenting will explain parentingBenefit % of the variance in offspring survival
parentingBenefit<-(.50)



#Mutation rate
mutationRate<-.05

```



```{r functions}

#Agent Generation#
#Generate the agents
agentGenerate <- function(population) {
  
  #Load the agents
  agents<-read.csv(list.files("model-outputs/sex-evolution",full.names=T)[population])
  
  #Limit to just the final generation of agents
  agents<-agents[agents$generation==max(agents$generation),]
  
  #Remove modelloop and generation columns for now
  agents<-agents[,-(1:2)]
  
  row.names(agents)<-1:nrow(agents)
  
  #Add a trait that reflects investment in competition over access to mates
  #As before, only Gene 1 will be expressed
  agents$mateCompetitionGene1<-runif(nrow(agents),0,1)
  agents$mateCompetitionGene2<-runif(nrow(agents),0,1)
  
  #Add a trait that reflects investment into parenting offspring
  #As before, only Gene 1 will be expressed
  agents$parentingGene1<-runif(nrow(agents),0,1)
  agents$parentingGene2<-runif(nrow(agents),0,1)
  
  #Create a unique agent ID
  agents$ID<-1:nrow(agents)
  
  agents<-agents[,c(9, 1:2,5,7,3:4,6,8)]
  
  #Output agents
  return(agents)
}



#Gamete Production#
#A function to produce gametes
gameteProduce <- function(agent) {
  #Generate a gamete that expresses the first set of parent genes
  #and randomly carries either set of the agent's genes
  if (rbinom(1, 1, .5)) {
    gamete <- agent[, c(1,2:5, 2:5)]
  } else{
    gamete <- agent
  }
  
  #Label columns
  colnames(gamete) <- c(
    'parentID',
    "gameteSizeExpressed",
    "fusionTargetExpressed",
    "mateCompetitionExpressed",
    "parentingExpressed",
    "gameteSizeGene",
    "fusionTargetGene",
    "mateCompetitionGene",
    "parentingGene"
  )
  
  #Output the gamete
  return(gamete)
  
}



#Reproduce#
#Produce offspring from gametes
reproduce <- function(focalGamete, targetGamete) {
  #If the gametes together meet the minimum resource threshold
  if ((focalGamete$gameteSizeExpressed + 
       targetGamete$gameteSizeExpressed) >= resourceThreshold) {
    #Generate the offspring from gametes
    #Randomly determine which gamete's genes will be in the expressed (first) position
    if (rbinom(1, 1, .5)) {
      offspring <- c(
        focalGamete$parentID,
        targetGamete$parentID,
        focalGamete$gameteSizeGene,
        focalGamete$fusionTargetGene,
        focalGamete$mateCompetitionGene,
        focalGamete$parentingGene,
        targetGamete$gameteSizeGene,
        targetGamete$fusionTargetGene,
        targetGamete$mateCompetitionGene,
        targetGamete$parentingGene
      )
    } else {
      offspring <- c(
        targetGamete$parentID,
        focalGamete$parentID,
        targetGamete$gameteSizeGene,
        targetGamete$fusionTargetGene,
        targetGamete$mateCompetitionGene,
        targetGamete$parentingGene,
        focalGamete$gameteSizeGene,
        focalGamete$fusionTargetGene,
        focalGamete$mateCompetitionGene,
        focalGamete$parentingGene
      )
    }
    
    #Mutation
    offspring[3:10] <- rnorm(8, offspring[3:10], mutationRate)
    
    #Convert to dataframe
    offspring <- data.frame(t(offspring))
    
    #Label columns
    colnames(offspring) <- c(
      'parent1ID',
      'parent2ID',
      "gameteSizeGene1",
      "fusionTargetGene1",
      "mateCompetitionGene1",
      "parentingGene1",
      "gameteSizeGene2",
      "fusionTargetGene2",
      "mateCompetitionGene2",
      "parentingGene2"
    )
    
    #Keep offspring traits within bounds
    offspring[c(3:4,7:8)] <- apply(offspring[c(3:4,7:8)], 2, function(x)
      ifelse(x > resources, resources, ifelse(
        x < (resources / maxGametes), (resources / maxGametes), x
      )))
    
    offspring[c(5:6,9:10)] <- apply(offspring[c(5:6,9:10)],2, function(x)
      ifelse(x>1, 1, ifelse(x<0, 0, x)))
    
    #Output offspring
    return(data.frame(offspring))
  } else {
    #If offspring is not viable, return nothing
    return(NULL)
  }
  
}



#Gamete Fusion#
#A function for simulating fusion of gametes
fusion <- function(gametes) {
  #Create a blank offspring dataframe
  offspring <- data.frame(
    'parent1ID'=NA,
    'parent2ID'=NA,
    "gameteSizeGene1" = NA,
    "fusionTargetGene1" = NA,
    "mateCompetitionGene1" = NA,
    "parentingGene1" = NA,
    "gameteSizeGene2" = NA,
    "fusionTargetGene2" = NA,
    "mateCompetitionGene2" = NA,
    "parentingGene2" = NA
  )
  
  #Convert gamete list to dataframe
  gametes <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, gametes)
  gametes <- as.data.frame(apply(gametes, 2, unlist))
  
  #Sort gamete dataframe according to reproduction priority
  
  #Create a reproductionPriority variable based on mate competition trait
  reproductionPriority<-gametes$mateCompetitionExpressed
  
  #Set ratio of variance in priority accounted for by competition equal to mateCompetitionBenefit
  reproductionPriority<-reproductionPriority + rnorm(length(reproductionPriority),0,
                                                   sqrt(var(reproductionPriority)*
                                                          ((1-mateCompetitionBenefit)/
                                                             mateCompetitionBenefit)))
  
  #Order gametes according to reproduction priority such that agents invested in competition tend to reproduce first
  gametes <- gametes[order(reproductionPriority,decreasing=T), ]
  
  #Loop through gametes
  while (nrow(gametes)>1) {
    #Select the first gamete to reproduce
    focalGamete <- gametes[1, ]
    
    #Remove the focal gamete from the gamete matrix so it can't self-fuse
    gametes <- gametes[-1, ]
    
    #Identify the gamete closest to the focal gamete's fusion target
    targetGamete<-gametes[which.min(abs(gametes$gameteSizeExpressed -
                                          focalGamete$fusionTargetExpressed)),]
    
    #Have the gametes fuse to produce an offspring
    offspring<-rbind(offspring,reproduce(focalGamete, targetGamete))
    
    #Remove the target gamete from the gamete matrix
    gametes<-gametes[-which.min(abs(gametes$gameteSizeExpressed -
                                      focalGamete$fusionTargetExpressed)),]
    
  }
  
  #Output the offspring
  return(offspring[-1, ])
}

```



```{r modelStart}

#Loop through model loops
for (p in 1:populations) {
  
  #Load in the agent population
  agents <- agentGenerate(p)
  
  #Determine starting population size
  popSize<-nrow(agents)
  
  #Create a dataframe to store agents
  data<-cbind("modelLoop"=p,"generation"=0,agents)
  
  #Loop through generations
  for (g in 1:generations) {
    
    #Pre-reproductive mortality
    #Some agents die before getting to reproduce by virtue of their investment in mate competition
    agents<-agents[which(rbinom(nrow(agents),
                          1,
                          1-(agents$mateCompetitionGene1*mateCompetitionCost))==1),]
    
    
    #Reduce agent resources according to investment in parenting
    #Some agents have their gamete budget reduced by virtue of investing in parenting
    agentResources<-resources*(1-(agents$parentingGene1*parentingCost))
    
    #Generate gametes for each agent
    gametes <- sapply(1:nrow(agents), function(x)
      
      as.matrix(t(
        sapply(1:floor(agentResources[x]/ agents$gameteSizeGene1[x]), function(y)
          gameteProduce(agents[x, ]))
        
      )))

    #Have gametes fuse to produce offspring
    offspring<-fusion(gametes)
    
    #Post-reproductive mortality
    #Some offspring die by virtue of their parents' investment in parenting
    #Create a variable to reflect post-reproductive mortality risk
    postReproMortalityRisk<-agents$parentingGene1[match(offspring$parent1ID,agents$ID)] +
      agents$parentingGene1[match(offspring$parent2ID,agents$ID)]
    
    #Set max/min equal to 1+2*parentingBenefit (multiplied by 2 to represent parenting contributions of each parent)
    postReproMortalityRisk<-postReproMortalityRisk + rnorm(length(postReproMortalityRisk),0,
                                                   sqrt(var(postReproMortalityRisk)*
                                                          ((1-parentingBenefit)/
                                                             parentingBenefit)))
    
    #Limit number of offspring to popSize
    #Offspring whose parents invested more in parenting are more likely to survive
    offspring<-offspring[order(postReproMortalityRisk,decreasing=T),]
    
    agents<-offspring[min(c(nrow(offspring),popSize)),]
    
    
    #Remove the first parentID column
    agents<-agents[,-1]
    
    #Rename it
    colnames(agents)[1]<-"ID"
    
    #Assign new IDs
    agents$ID<-1:nrow(agents)
    
    #Save agents to overall data frame
    data<-rbind(data,cbind("modelLoop"=p,"generation"=g,agents))
    
  }
  
  #Create a unique filename and filepath
  path <- "model-outputs/sex-evolution/MSAG Sex Evolution Population "
  
  format <- ".csv"
  date <- format(Sys.time(), format = "%Y%m%d %H%M")
  file <- file.path(paste0(path, m, " ", date, format))
  
  #Save model data
  write.csv(data, file = file, row.names = F)
}
```
